steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Ngh...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I didn't cut off your hands! Pick yourself up!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: ...Don't you dare think this is over!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll cut out your tongue right here, then.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Off he goes.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Are you oka—

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: What have you done! Oh, God, Talulah... Look at what you've done!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Talulah, we'll have to transport the village in two days. Just look at what you've...!

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: You fought a patrolman! There'll be hell to pay now!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Letting him beat you was even less of an idea. It's getting late, and he's on the run. If I kill him now, we'll be long gone by the time the others find his remains.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But that wouldn't solve any of our problems. Once the patrol unit regroups, they'd still come looking for us. They might well be out to get revenge on us.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: And yet you did it! Now what do we do!?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Calm down. They're looking for Infected. They still don't know.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Don't know what?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They don't know what I'm about to do.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Hey... Talulah!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's okay. Come on, I'll walk you back.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Your leg there... It will need special attention to heal.

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Hah. So today's the day you start helping me walk? Always thought I was still in good shape myself. Who'd've guessed I couldn't outrun it?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Talulah, there's something I need to tell you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Ah, good question. Heh, hahah, sorry, I don't remember. Look at me now. Look at my memory...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's some impressive forgetfulness, alright.
